==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will only use this skill if their current target is knocked down or stationary.

== Notes ==
* Consider using a [[cancel stance]], especially ones with energy costs and/or low recharges, such as [[Dash]].
* Commonly used by [[hammer]] warriors. The self-snare is mitigated when used against [[Knock down|knocked down]] [[target]]s.
* Commonly used in [[PvE]], where [[foe]]s rarely [[kite]].
** A perfect ''[[of the (Profession)|of the Warrior]]'' weapon [[upgrade]] can increase the duration from 1 to 6 seconds, making it a viable option for any [[martial]] profession, even without a cancel stance.

== Trivia ==
*The warrior in the [[skill icon]] wears [[Sunspear Armor]].
*A similar looking warrior also appears on the skill icons of [[Headbutt]], [[Enraging Charge]] and [[Lion's Comfort]].
